combo_label: Birthdays × Coffee & Cafés × The Tower of London

entries.clue: Handful of words scribbled inside the card, just above the signature
Knack you were born with, or the box handed over with a ribbon
Espresso diluted with hot water, named after the drinkers it was said to suit.
Bundle passed round a circle to music, shedding a layer each time
Make a joyful fuss of a day that deserves it
Tall glass pot whose mesh plunger is pressed down after about four minutes.
Broad ribbon worn shoulder to hip, marking out whose day it is
Alkaloid that gives the cup its lift and can keep you awake at night.
Gorilla or chimpanzee; primates of many kinds lived in the Tower's menagerie
Norman town whose pale limestone was shipped over to dress the great keep
Young lion, of the sort born in the royal menagerie kept at the Tower
Chalkboard list of drinks and cakes, with prices beside each.
Solemn promise sworn by every new warder at a ceremony on Tower Green
